name: band assisted floor glute ham raise
description: Floor glute ham raise where a band helps you come back up. It builds the hamstrings and glutes with a manageable load.
instructions: Anchor a band at head height and loop it around your chest or hold it to your chest.
Kneel with your feet held firmly under a stable object.
Lower your torso forward slowly with a straight line from knees to head.
Pull yourself back up with your hamstrings and glutes, using the band to help.
